system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park launched mstsc.exe to FILE-HD-01 from WS-LPARK-01, and FILE-HD-01 recorded a successful remote-interactive logon for her from that workstation.
That RDP activity is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-OHADDAD-01; the records show Lucy's connection originated from WS-LPARK-01.
A UserAssist registry value written on WS-LPARK-01 contains a ROT13-encoded path corresponding to powershell.exe, but this record alone does not establish what PowerShell command, if any, was run.
The supplied records do not show an account-creation event for tmp.rwong or identify who created it.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage metadata reports that both winsec and sysmon collection on DC-HD-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alert's reported account-creation time. No record IDs are available for this coverage metadata.
The supplied records do not include a PowerShell process-creation event or command line for the activity suggested by the UserAssist value.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was actually created, when it was created, or which user or process created it.
Whether tmp.rwong was added only to Temp-Staff or received any other group membership or privileges.
Whether Lucy Park's RDP session and the PowerShell-related activity were authorized or connected to the reported account creation.
What commands or actions, if any, were performed during the RDP session.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-HD-01 account-management audit events for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including creator identity, account attributes, group membership, and privilege changes for tmp.rwong.
Obtain FILE-HD-01 process and security logs for Lucy Park's RDP session, including process command lines and any account-management activity.
Confirm with the help desk whether Lucy Park's RDP session and any PowerShell use were authorized and related to a documented temporary-account request.
Obtain relevant endpoint telemetry from WS-LPARK-01 to determine whether PowerShell actually ran and, if so, its command line and parent process.
